tolerance_policy.frequency: 10 % of the reference value -- the TR-808's own component tolerance on an oscillator's f0 (docs/tr808-reference.md 1.7)
tolerance_policy.time: 50 % of the reference value -- 1.7 states +-50 % on Q, and for these bridged-T resonators tau is proportional to Q
tolerance_policy.energy ratio: 3 dB, the half-power convention. A stated convention, not a number derived from any error of ours
tolerance_policy.event timing: 10 ms -- the positional accuracy audio_measure.onsets states for itself; a failure is larger than the estimator's own resolution
tolerance_policy.bus sum: 0.5 dB -- the final output must be the sum of the per-bus stems
tolerance_policy.rail: 0.01 % of samples at the rail, a stated budget for a render with no limiter in the path
tolerance_policy.rolloff: 1.5 dB per octave -- audio_measure.slope_db_oct's own max_residual_db. That estimator REFUSES a straight-line fit whose RMS residual exceeds it, so a difference smaller than it is inside the fit's own scatter and is not a difference. A number the estimator states about itself, not one derived from any error of ours
